mapper.sql: select sl.id, sl.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, sl.material_id, sl.material_batch_id, sl.operation_type, CASE sl.operation_type WHEN 'inbound' THEN '入库' WHEN 'outbound' THEN '出库' ELSE '' END as operation_type_name, sl.change_quantity, sl.before_quantity, sl.after_quantity, sl.reference_order_id, sl.operator, sl.created_at from stock_log sl left join inv_warehouse w on sl.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id and w.del_flag = '0'
